title: Universal worker admission service and placement integration
intent: All worker-backed placement families delegate common availability, scheduling, price, selector, pressure, and dynamic headroom checks to one admission service. Workerless LLM external_api placement explicitly bypasses worker admission.
observed_before: worker_policy.go, ml_placement.go, llm_placement.go, and backup_placement.go duplicated liveness/scheduling/price/selector checks
llm_placement.go did not enforce worker scheduling state for runtime-backed placements
Workers without telemetry were not conservatively rejected for dynamic headroom requests
intended_behavior: Admission evaluates ordered common checks before family-specific scoring
Standard placements reject cleanup_only and blocked capacity classes
Telemetry-missing workers remain eligible for non-dynamic standard placement with reduced capacity, but reject when memory/disk/VRAM headroom is requested
LLM external_api placement returns an explicit workerless bypass reason
